SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.USER_ID AS userId, P.TITLE AS title, P.STATUS_CODE AS statusCode, P.CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, AS nickname, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_COMMENT C WHERE C.POST_ID = P.POST_ID AND C.STATUS_CODE <> 'DELETED') AS commentCount, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM BOARD_POST P LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = P.USER_ID
ORDER BY commentCount DESC, P.CREATED_AT DESC, P.POST_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT P.POST_ID AS postId, P.USER_ID AS userId, P.TITLE AS title, P.CONTENT AS content, P.STATUS_CODE AS statusCode, P.CATEGORY_CODE AS categoryCode, AS nickname, P.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, P.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM BOARD_POST P LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = P.USER_ID WHERE P.POST_ID = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD_POST (USER_ID, CATEGORY_CODE, TITLE, CONTENT, STATUS_CODE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{userId}, #{categoryCode}, #{title}, #{content}, 'VISIBLE', #{createdAt})

INSERT INTO BOARD_POST_LOG (POST_ID, ACTION_CODE, ACTOR_TYPE_CODE, ACTOR_USER_ID, BEFORE_STATUS_CODE, AFTER_STATUS_CODE, REPORT_ID, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{postId}, #{actionCode}, #{actorTypeCode}, #{actorUserId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{beforeStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{afterStatus}, #{reportId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, C.POST_ID AS postId, C.USER_ID AS userId, C.CONTENT AS content, C.STATUS_CODE AS statusCode, AS nickname, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM BOARD_COMMENT C LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} AND C.STATUS_CODE <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT, C.COMMENT_ID

SELECT C.COMMENT_ID AS commentId, C.POST_ID AS postId, C.USER_ID AS userId, C.CONTENT AS content, C.STATUS_CODE AS statusCode, CASE WHEN P.STATUS_CODE = 'VISIBLE' THEN P.CATEGORY_CODE END AS categoryCode, CASE WHEN P.STATUS_CODE = 'VISIBLE' THEN P.TITLE END AS postTitle, CASE WHEN P.STATUS_CODE = 'VISIBLE' THEN END AS postNickname, C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM BOARD_COMMENT C JOIN BOARD_POST P ON P.POST_ID = C.POST_ID LEFT JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = P.USER_ID
ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT DESC, C.COMMENT_ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
